quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #5
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: What is the speed limit on urban or town roads if no other speed limit is posted?
questions.explanation: The speed limit on urban or town roads is 30 mph. Always follow posted speed limit signs if they show a different speed.

questions.question: What should drivers do when preparing to turn left?

options.text: Slow down gradually while checking the rearview mirror
Watch for oncoming vehicles and pedestrians

questions.explanation: When turning left, signal 3 to 5 seconds before you turn. Check your rearview mirror and slow down gradually. On a multi-lane road, move into the left lane before the intersection. Make sure the path is clear of traffic and pedestrians before turning.

questions.question: Which statement about railroad crossings is correct?

options.text: It is illegal to go around lowered crossing gates
You must stop when a flagger tells you to stop at a railroad crossing
Not all railroad crossings have flashing red lights and gates

questions.explanation: You must stop at a railroad crossing when a flagger, stop sign, or warning devices tell you to. Not all railroad crossings have lights or gates. It is illegal to drive around lowered railroad crossing gates.

questions.question: Only authorized emergency or maintenance vehicles can have blue lights, flashing lights, or strobe lights.
questions.explanation: Blue lights, flashing lights, and strobe lights are only for authorized emergency and maintenance vehicles. Other drivers cannot use these lights on their vehicles.

questions.question: When crossing railroad tracks with no signals or gates, what should you do?

options.text: You have the right-of-way and do not need to check for trains
You may pass slower drivers while crossing the tracks
Make sure your vehicle can cross the tracks completely without stopping

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure your vehicle can cross the tracks completely without stopping
questions.explanation: Before driving onto railroad tracks, check that you have enough room to cross all the way without stopping. Never pass another vehicle at a railroad crossing. Always check for trains before crossing any tracks.

questions.question: What should you do at an intersection with a yield sign?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection
Yield only to traffic on the right
Yield only to traffic on the left
Slow down and give the right-of-way to other traffic

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and give the right-of-way to other traffic
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic in the intersection or on the roadway go first.

questions.question: When should you signal before passing another vehicle?

options.text: Early enough so other drivers know your plans

questions.correctAnswerText: Early enough so other drivers know your plans
questions.explanation: Signal early before you pass so other drivers know what you plan to do ahead of time.

questions.question: When should you use your horn?

options.text: When you see a child about to run into the street

questions.correctAnswerText: When you see a child about to run into the street
questions.explanation: Use your horn as a warning when another driver or pedestrian might not see you. For example, honk if a child starts to run into the street in front of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does a steady yellow light at an intersection mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and prepare to stop
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means a red light is coming soon. Slow down and be ready to stop. If you are already in the intersection or cannot stop safely, continue through carefully.

questions.question: When can you go through a stop sign intersection that has no stop line or crosswalk?

options.text: After slowing down to check that there is no cross traffic
After coming to a complete stop and checking that it is safe
After stopping at least 20 feet before the intersection

questions.correctAnswerText: After coming to a complete stop and checking that it is safe
questions.explanation: Stop before entering any intersection with a stop sign. If there is no stop line or crosswalk, stop before the intersection. Only proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What is the best way to handle a tailgater?

options.text: Speed up to create more distance between you.
Brake hard to make them back off.
Change lanes or slow down gradually to let them pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes or slow down gradually to let them pass.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors often to watch for tailgaters or fast-approaching cars. If someone is following too closely, slow down and let them pass. Most rear-end crashes happen because drivers follow too closely.

questions.question: Who must yield when a driver turns and a pedestrian crosses without a traffic light?
questions.explanation: Drivers must yield to pedestrians crossing at any intersection without a traffic light, with or without a crosswalk.

questions.question: What does a green arrow with a red light mean?

options.text: You can only drive straight ahead.
You can only drive in the direction of the arrow.
You must wait for a solid green light before going in any direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can only drive in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: A green arrow with a red light means you can only drive in the direction shown by the arrow, and only if the intersection is clear.

questions.question: If two drivers arrive at an open intersection at the same time, who has the right-of-way?

options.text: One driver can go without stopping.
One driver should honk to give up the right-of-way.

questions.explanation: If you arrive at an open intersection at the same time as a vehicle to your right, you must yield to them. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does alcohol cause?
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol hurts your vision, judgment, focus, and coordination.

questions.question: Can you cross a double solid yellow line to pass another vehicle?

options.text: Yes, if there is no oncoming traffic.
Yes, if the car ahead is below the speed limit.

questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no driver can cross them, except when turning into a driveway or business entrance. Passing over a solid yellow line is never allowed.

questions.question: When can you pass another vehicle?

options.text: In a curve or on a hill because oncoming traffic is unlikely.
By driving on the highway shoulder.
If your lane has a solid yellow line and the passing lane is clear.

questions.explanation: Do not pass on hills or in curves because you cannot see oncoming traffic. Never pass by driving on the shoulder. Never pass by crossing a solid yellow line.

questions.question: If a driver is worried, nervous, angry, or crying, they should:

options.text: Drive faster because emotions sharpen their senses.
Calm down and focus before starting the car.
Call a friend to talk while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Calm down and focus before starting the car.
questions.explanation: Strong emotions can hurt your driving because your mind is on something else. Take time to calm down and get focused before you drive.

questions.question: Can you drive above the speed limit to pass on a road with a speed limit under 55 mph?
questions.explanation: On multi-lane roads where passing is allowed, you may pass on the left. Do not exceed the speed limit when passing unless the speed limit is 55 mph or higher.

questions.question: When can a driver legally pass on the right side of another vehicle?

options.text: If the vehicle is waiting to turn left and there is a passing lane available.
Even if it means driving off the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: If the vehicle is waiting to turn left and there is a passing lane available.
questions.explanation: You may pass on the right of a vehicle turning left if there is an available passing lane. You can also pass on the right on multi-lane roads with two or more lanes going the same direction. Never drive off the road to pass another vehicle.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause you to crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel
Take your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: A distraction is anything that takes your attention away from driving, takes your eyes off the road, or takes your hands off the wheel.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means you cannot do the action shown. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: While driving at night, you may use your parking lights instead of headlights.
questions.explanation: You cannot drive at night using only parking lights. You must use your headlights when it is dark or visibility is low.

questions.question: When riding in a vehicle, small children:

options.text: May be safely held by a strong adult.
Will be safe if they stand on the floor in the back.
Will not be hurt in an accident because they are small.
Must never be allowed to ride while standing in the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must never be allowed to ride while standing in the vehicle.
questions.explanation: Children need special car seats or proper safety belts. No adult is strong enough to hold a child safely during a crash or sudden stop. Children must always be properly secured in a seat.

questions.question: When driving in fog, you should use your low beam headlights:
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. High beams reflect off the fog and shine back into your eyes, making it harder to see.

questions.question: You should signal to turn ____ before beginning the turn.
questions.explanation: Signal at least 100 feet before you turn or change lanes. Keep signaling until you finish the turn or lane change.

questions.question: You are waiting to turn left at a multilane intersection and opposing traffic is blocking your view. You should:

options.text: Speed up when the first lane you need to cross is clear.
Wait until you can see all the lanes you need to cross before turning.
Wait for an oncoming driver to wave you across.
Move your car into each lane as soon as it clears.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until you can see all the lanes you need to cross before turning.
questions.explanation: Never start a left turn unless you can see that all the lanes you need to cross are clear and it is safe to turn.

questions.question: A diamond-shaped sign:

options.text: Warns of existing or possible hazards.
Alerts drivers to public recreation areas.
Alerts drivers to upcoming food and gas locations.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns of existing or possible hazards.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn you of hazards ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: At a light rail intersection, always:

options.text: Look both ways before crossing tracks.
Pay attention and obey all traffic signals.
Share the road with pedestrians and bicyclists.

questions.explanation: Never drive around lowered crossing gates. Always look both ways before crossing train tracks. Always obey signs and traffic signals. Share the road with trains, pedestrians, and bicyclists.

questions.question: If another car is about to hit you, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Use your horn to warn other drivers or pedestrians who may not see you. If you think another driver is about to hit you, sound your horn immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: You see a sign that says "Reduced speed, 35 mph." What does this mean?

options.text: The new 35 mph speed limit starts at this sign.
The new 35 mph speed limit starts at the next speed limit sign.
You have plenty of time to slow down before the reduced speed zone.
You should reduce speed to 35 mph only in bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: The new 35 mph speed limit starts at this sign.
questions.explanation: A "reduced speed" sign tells you to slow down. The new speed limit begins right at that sign.

questions.question: Talking or texting on a cell phone while driving does not greatly increase your chance of a crash.
questions.explanation: Using a phone while driving is a distraction that increases your risk of crashing.

questions.question: A solid green light means you:

options.text: Must slow down and get ready to stop.
Must stop and check for oncoming traffic first.
Can drive through if the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can drive through if the road is clear.
questions.explanation: A solid green light means you may drive through the intersection if it is clear. You may also turn right or left unless a sign says you cannot. Always yield to other vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection.

questions.question: It is safe to use cruise control on snowy or icy roads if you reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: Do not use cruise control on snow or ice. Your tires can lose grip on the road, and you will lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does an orange sign mean?

options.text: The start of a no passing zone.

questions.explanation: Orange signs show construction, maintenance, or emergency work ahead.

questions.question: Which of these increases the risk of a crash?
questions.explanation: Cell phones, radios, and CD players can all distract you from driving and increase your crash risk.

questions.question: Night driving compared to day driving is:
questions.explanation: Night driving is more dangerous because it is harder to see, headlights can blind you, and tired or impaired drivers are more common at night.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane on the road is ending. Traffic in that lane must move left.
